```{r}
library(ape)
library(phangorn)
library(ggtree)
library(ggplot2)
library(msa)
library(Biostrings)
library(dplyr)
source("Rfunctions/SELEXseqFunctions.R")
```

## make tree
```{r}
# Run the function
final_plot <- generate_hox_tree("Alignments/HoxSequence.fasta")

# Display the plot
print(final_plot)

# Run the function
final_plot <- generate_hox_tree("Alignments/HoxSequence.fasta", remove_gaps = F)

# Display the plot
print(final_plot)
```



## load HD hmm alignment
```{r}
HoxAli <- FamilyCode::ExtractHmm("Alignments/HoxHmm.sto")
colnames(HoxAli) <- c('name', 'seq')
FamilyCode::writeFasta(HoxAli, "Alignments/HoxAli.fasta")
```

## make hox alignment tree
```{r}
#>AbdB_dmel
#RKKRKPYSKFQTLELEKEFLFNAYVSKQKRWELARNLQLTERQVKIWFQNRRMKNKK
# Run the function
final_plot <- generate_hox_tree("Alignments/HoxAli.fasta")

# Display the plot
print(final_plot+ggplot2::ggtitle('HD only'))

final_plot <- generate_hox_tree("Alignments/HoxAli.fasta", remove_gaps = FALSE)

# Display the plot
print(final_plot+ggplot2::ggtitle('HD only'))
```



## YPWM alignment
```{r}
my_seqs <- readAAStringSet("Alignments/HoxSequence.fasta")

# 2. Perform Alignment (using ClustalW, Muscle, or Omega)
# Computes the Multiple Sequence Alignment
my_aln <- msa(my_seqs, method = "ClustalW")

# 3. Export to Stockholm
write_stockholm(my_aln, "Alignments/HoxSequence.sto")
YPWMAli <- FamilyCode::ExtractHmm("Alignments/HoxSequence.sto")
colnames(YPWMAli) <- c('name', 'seq')
YPWMstart <- unlist(gregexpr('YPWM', YPWMAli$seq))[1]
HOXend <- unlist(gregexpr('MKLKK', YPWMAli$seq))[1]

YPWMAli$seq <- substr(YPWMAli$seq, YPWMstart - 5, HOXend + 15)
YPWMAli$seq <- gsub('-','',YPWMAli$seq)
FamilyCode::writeFasta(YPWMAli, "Alignments/YPWMAli.fasta")

final_plot <- generate_hox_tree("Alignments/YPWMAli.fasta")

# Display the plot
print(final_plot+ggplot2::ggtitle('YPWM included'))

final_plot <- generate_hox_tree("Alignments/YPWMAli.fasta", remove_gaps = FALSE)

# Display the plot
print(final_plot+ggplot2::ggtitle('YPWM included'))
```
